## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up both the plastic soda bottle and the bottle with yellow sticker label together.

Task description: The targets are the red-label plastic soda bottle on the left and the large drink bottle with an orange cap and yellow-orange label on the right. Move both into their corresponding regions in front of the robot and keep both lifted simultaneously.

Success criteria: The soda bottle with the red label must be above the left target region near the robot at the center of the table, and the drink bottle with the orange cap and yellow label above the adjacent right target region. Both must be clearly raised and held in the air simultaneously. A slight lift at their original positions is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Choose straight bottle-body sections that allow full pad contact. Consider the straight waist below the red bottle's label and the straight labeled sidewall of the orange-capped bottle. Avoid curved shoulders and protruding bases to reduce slippage.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp point. Check from a side view that the fingers are on opposite sides of the bottle before closing, to avoid pushing it over with the fingertips despite apparent overlap in the image.
- Make a small test lift to see whether the bottle body slides down along the pads. If a regrasp is needed, first let the bottle bottom rest on the table again before releasing, avoiding a drop while suspended.
- As the bottles converge toward the front center, leave clearance around their shoulders, bottoms, and both grippers. A yellow pump bottle and upright object are near the right bottle; make larger pose adjustments in open space to reduce sweeping collisions.
